<thought>We need to apply retrosynthetic template 20810 to the target molecule SMILES provided. Using the apply_template tool will give us the possible precursor sets. The result should be formatted as a list of lists, each inner list containing the SMILES strings of the precursors for one possible disconnection.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O",
    "template_id": "20810"
}</action_input>
